---
title: "Figure 2. Structural annotation and supporting evidence for the ovarian transcript catalog"
engine: knitr
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
                     cache = FALSE, fig.align = "left", out.width = "100%")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  
})

DATA_DIR <- file.path("data", "Fig2")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path("figures", "Fig2")
FONT_FAMILY <- "Arial"
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
INPUT_C_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig2C_structural_categories.tsv")
INPUT_D_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig2D_coding_composition.tsv")
INPUT_H_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig2H_isoforms_per_gene.tsv")

CONFIG_C <- list(colors = c(FSM = "#A6274B", ISM = "#F15A4A", NIC = "#E2A06B", 
NNC = "#315AA6", Others = "#4D9F50"))

CONFIG_D <- list(colors = c(Coding = "#3F9B8F", NMD = "#C49A3A", Non_coding = "#8A6FB0"
), class_order = c("FSM", "ISM", "NIC", "NNC", "Others"))

CONFIG_H <- list()

read_input <- function(file, levels = list()) {
  data <- read.delim(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = "NA")
  for (column in names(levels)) data[[column]] <- factor(data[[column]], levels[[column]])
  data
}

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)))
save_panel <- function(name, plot, width, height) {
  draw <- function() if (is.function(plot)) plot() else print(plot)
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
                      width = width, height = height, family = FONT_FAMILY)
  draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
                width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 600, background = "white")
  draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

## Transcript structural classes

Percentages use the 107,155-transcript catalog.

```{r}
#| label: Fig2C_structural_categories
panel <- CONFIG_C
table <- read_input(INPUT_C_DATA, list(class_code = c("FSM", "ISM", "NIC", "NNC", "Others")))
panel$data <- table

p <- ggplot(panel$data, aes(class_code, count, fill = class_code)) +
  geom_col(width = .7, colour = "black", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", perc)), vjust = -.5,
            size = 3.5, family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel$colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Isoforms (count)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
save_panel("Fig2C_structural_categories", p, 4.6, 4.2)
```

## Coding composition by structural class

NMD denotes predicted nonsense-mediated decay.

```{r}
#| label: Fig2D_coding_composition
panel <- CONFIG_D
table <- read_input(INPUT_D_DATA, list())
panel$data <- table

d <- panel$data
d$class_code <- factor(d$class_code, levels = panel$class_order)
d$codingType <- factor(d$codingType, levels = names(panel$colors))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(class_code, perc / 100, fill = codingType)) +
  geom_col(width = .72) + scale_fill_manual(values = panel$colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction within structural category")
save_panel("Fig2D_coding_composition", p, 6, 4.4)
```

![](figures/Fig2/Fig2D_coding_composition.png){fig-alt="Coding composition by structural class" width=100%}

[PDF](figures/Fig2/Fig2D_coding_composition.pdf) · [PNG](figures/Fig2/Fig2D_coding_composition.png)

## Isoforms per gene

```{r}
#| label: Fig2H_isoforms_per_gene
panel <- CONFIG_H
table <- read_input(INPUT_H_DATA, list(count_cat = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5+")))
panel$data <- table

p <- ggplot(panel$data, aes(count_cat, gene_count, fill = count_cat)) +
  geom_col(width = .7, colour = "black", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", perc)), vjust = -.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12))) +
  labs(x = "Number of associated isoforms", y = "Gene count") + theme(legend.position = "none")
save_panel("Fig2H_isoforms_per_gene", p, 5, 4.3)
```
